title: Become an American State National By Anna Von Reitz
summary: Anna Von Reitz text urging people to become American State Nationals, join state jural assemblies and complete a Reconstruction she says never ended.

assertions.quote: by expatriated from all presumed territorial and municipal citizenships as to lawfully convert legal persons back into lawful persons
reconfigured as the Articles of Incorporation for a Scottish commercial corporation that went bankrupt in 1907
the state journal assembly takes up judicial issues that affect the people of the state and the enforcement of the public law

verdicts.note: These assemblies have no legal standing; their 'courts' and rulings are unrecognised and members have been prosecuted for acting on them.

assertions.quote: acting as jurors in actual trials can throw out any law that they find repugnant to the public good

verdicts.note: Criminal juries can acquit against the evidence, but that sets no precedent and does not void any law, and judges may remove jurors who announce it.

assertions.quote: that transition has never taken place

verdicts.note: Reconstruction ended in 1877 and civilian constitutional government has operated since; the claim has no documentary basis.
